# Paul Rusu

> Paul Rusu (Rusu Adrian Paul) is a senior full-stack developer based in Zalău, Romania, with 10+ years of experience building web platforms end to end. He works remotely and is open to new full-time roles.

## Profile

- Senior full-stack developer: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Java/Spring, PostgreSQL, AWS and self-hosted infrastructure.
- Leads engineering for clients end to end: technical direction, building teams, and taking applications from first idea to production.
- Modernizes existing systems (in-house frameworks to Spring, Angular to React, PHP to Next.js) without disrupting the business.
- Uses AI-assisted development and agentic workflows, backed by testing and code review.
- 10+ clients, 20+ projects, 5+ countries, features used by more than 1M users.

## Experience

- Jun 2024 – present: Senior Web Developer (contract), We as Web, for a global sports betting and gaming group. High-traffic customer pages, internal promotion and user management tools, privacy consent flows, framework migrations.
- May 2021 – present: Full-Stack Developer & Technical Consultant (independent). Work on imobiliare.ro; crypto and web3 applications; event-driven apps on AWS.
- Dec 2021 – Feb 2024: Senior Developer & Technical Lead, StarChain Solutions. Led a cross-functional team; web3 integrations for games by Animoca Brands; Motorverse pre-signup website.
- Nov 2018 – May 2021: Web Developer, 3Pillar Global. Search and media platforms for clients including LexisNexis and Fortune.
- Aug 2017 – Oct 2018: UI Web Developer, Pitech Plus.
- Jun 2016 – Jul 2017: Web Developer, HSDS. Revenue management application and dashboards for international hotel brands.

## Projects

- Hyper: ERP back office, multi-vendor marketplace and storefront for Romanian businesses. Runs as a multi-tenant SaaS or as a white-label deployment per client. TypeScript, Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, Stripe, ANAF e-Factura.
- Cazare Mihaieni (https://cazaremihaieni.ro): bilingual booking website for holiday cottages, live and bringing in direct bookings.
